verdict.rationale: OpenTofu ships as an official CLI (`tofu`). The docs cover its commands: `tofu plan` with speculative, destroy and refresh-only modes, `tofu test`, `tofu import`, saved plans via `-out=FILE`, `-exclude` targeting, and multi-OS install. Community users confirm the CLI drops in for terraform in real projects. Missing for 10: evidence of machine-readable (JSON) output or non-interactive/automation flags tailored to agent-driven use, and hands-on corroboration of AI-agent CLI workflows specifically.
